item.title: RUMOR: The AVENGERS Will Face Some Incredibly Powerful Villains Post-SECRET WARS - Possible SPOILERS
item.description: Earth's Mightiest Heroes have already faced-off against some very powerful bad guys in the MCU, but a new rumor claims that their post-Secret Wars foes may take the threat to another level...

item.title: Paramount’s David Ellison Details How WBD CEO David Zaslav Stopped Responding To His Texts Before Netflix Deal
item.description: A new update has come out about Paramount’s efforts to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery, as Paramount CEO David Ellison has revealed WBD’s CEO David Zaslav stopped responding to his texts before Netflix win.

item.title: ABSOLUTE BATMAN #15 Spoilers: Absolute Joker's Twisted Origin Story Has Been Revealed
item.description: Absolute Batman #15 finally reveals the Absolute Joker's twisted origin story, with some shocking revelations that lay the groundwork for Bruce Wayne's biggest challenge yet.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Trailer Teaser Features Krypton First Look And Kara Taking Flight; Times Square Countdown Revealed
item.description: A trailer teaser for Supergirl just landed, and it features new scenes from the movie, including a first look at the DCU's take on Krypton and Kara taking flight.

item.title: THE AMAZING SPIDER-MAN: Josh Hutcherson Reflects On "Heartbreaking" Experience Of Losing Peter Parker Role
item.description: The Hunger Games star Josh Hutcherson has reflected on being in the running for the role of Peter Parker in 2012's The Amazing Spider-Man and recalls when it was like being told "no."

item.title: Amazon Takes A Shot At SUPERMAN’s David Corenswet On Social Media Following Controversial Masculinity Comment
item.description: Amazon has used the Invincible series to take a swipe at masculinity comments made by Superman star David Corenswet, which became controversial online.

item.title: Steven Spielberg's Mysterious UFO Film First Look Revealed Along With Possible Title & Plot Details - SPOILERS
item.description: Ahead of the first trailer debuting with Avatar: Fire and Ash, we have a first look at the poster for Steven Spielberg's mysterious "UFO movie," which might just be connected to one of his classics...

item.title: 28 YEARS LATER 3 Moving Forward At Sony With Cillian Murphy In Talks To Return
item.description: Following the phenomenal early reception for 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple, Sony is moving forward with the threequel, which will mark the return original star Cillian Murphy to the franchise.

item.title: Jennifer Lawrence & Josh Hutcherson Confirmed To Return For THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING
item.description: Here's some major midweek news as it's being reported that original Hunger Games stars Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson will both reprise their roles in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping!
